character.name: Ece
character.current_goal: Help Mert understand whether a chalk arrow near their seed-box table is connected to their project.
established_knowledge: GREENHOUSE_DOOR is discovered and may be seen from the public garden.
GLASS_PASSAGE is only rumored and Ece has never entered it.
Mert placed the shared seed box on the garden table earlier that morning.
prohibited_knowledge: Ece does not know who drew the chalk arrow.
Ece does not know what is inside GLASS_PASSAGE.
Ece does not know whether greenhouse staff use chalk arrows for maintenance.

local_areas.summary: Public learning table with seed boxes and chalk.
Open beds, labels and paths used by children and families.
Closed greenhouse entrance visible from the public path.
A rumored service passage beyond the closed greenhouse; must remain unexplored.

current_facts: A fresh chalk arrow points from the shared table toward a public watering shelf.
Mert is worried someone moved or borrowed part of their seed-box project.
The shared seed box is still on the table.
A small packet of blue plant labels is missing from the top tray.
hidden_facts_not_available_to_story: The original author of the chalk arrow is intentionally unknown.
No canonical fact connects GLASS_PASSAGE to the missing labels.

opportunity.title: Understand the chalk arrow from known ground
opportunity.premise: Ece can help Mert investigate the arrow and missing label packet using only public garden evidence.
opportunity.success_condition: Resolve whether their project is actually missing something important and preserve uncertainty about unsupported causes.
constraints: Do not identify the arrow's author without evidence.
Do not create danger or an adult rescue.

hard_rules: Character knowledge cannot exceed experienced or explicitly communicated facts.
Social misunderstandings should resolve without humiliation.

eligible_context: Ece is learning to ask before assuming what another person meant.
Ece and Mert enjoy small shared garden projects.
forbidden_reveal: Do not reveal future greenhouse access.
Do not establish a secret club or hidden antagonist.

relevant_memories.summary: Ece once blamed the wind for a missing paper label before discovering she had tucked it under a notebook.
relevant_memories.relevance: Supports checking simple explanations before assigning blame.
